outline: To build the quantitative logic thinking about the decision problems. The course is designed to introduce the fundamental techniques and methods of operations research. The related software will be utilized to aid in building and solving models. The topics to be covered: linear programming, what-if analysis, dual theory, transportation and assignment.
schedule:
Week1. Introduction to Modeling in OR
Week2~3. Formulations in Linear Programming
Week4. Graphical Solution and Basic Solution (BV and NBV)
Week5~7. Simplex Method
Week8~10. Artificial Starting Solution
Week11-12. Shadow Price and Sensitivity Analysis
Week13~15. Transportation Model and Assignment Model
Week16. Final Exam

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content:
Week 17. LAB Solve using Excel
Week 18. Optional Distance Learning

Attendance and Lab: 20%

Final Exam:  20%
